description: The NBI database collects performance, costs, benefits and externalities from nature-based infrastructure assessments. The resource is documented by IISD Nature-Based Infrastructure Global Resource Centre. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. Only provider metadata and documentation were inspected; runnable files, underlying datasets and claimed results were not tested. The documented functions can inform infrastructure simulation inputs, intervention comparisons or operational scenarios. Numerical performance was not independently checked. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
